name: 48301 · Bloomfld Hls, MI
findings: ZIP 48301 (Bloomfld Hls) has 113 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48301 (Bloomfld Hls) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
